# APP-2 Calculation of Gross Floor Area<br><small>總樓面面積的計算</small>

## At a glance 重點摘要

=== "English"

    - **Car parks**: underground **100%** disregarded. Above ground: **100%** for up to 2 floors, **50%** for the rest.
    - **Curtain walls** may project up to **200 mm** (domestic).

=== "中文"

    - **停車場**：地庫 **100%** 不計。
